component.name: Aster
component.summary: Watch your Jellyfin library with a controller

description.p: Aster is a native Jellyfin client for Linux, designed for a television and gamepad. Browse your movies and shows, resume playback, and watch in the same window.

ul.li: Controller navigation with clear focus and an on-screen keyboard
Continue Watching, search, favorites, seasons and episodes
Hardware-accelerated playback, audio and subtitle menus, and chapters

description.p: A Jellyfin server is required. Aster is in alpha.
